description: This file implements a set of functions and classes for managing Feishu documents, including creating, reading, updating, deleting, and inserting content such as tables, images, and blocks. It also registers tools for document operations within a plugin API, supporting actions like convert markdown, upload images/files, and manipulate document blocks.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Wraps data into a JSON response with content and details fields.

methods.name: extractImageUrls
methods.description: Extracts image URLs from markdown content using regex.

methods.name: cleanBlocksForInsert
methods.description: Removes unsupported block types and read-only fields from blocks before insertion.

methods.name: convertMarkdown
methods.description: Converts markdown content to document blocks via API call.

methods.name: normalizeChildIds
methods.description: Normalizes children input into an array of string IDs.

methods.name: toCreateChildBlock
methods.description: Converts a block to a create-child API format.

methods.name: toDescendantBlock
methods.description: Converts a block to a descendant API format.

methods.name: normalizeInsertedChildBlocks
methods.description: Filters and normalizes inserted child blocks.

methods.name: normalizeConvertedBlockTree
methods.description: Reconstructs a block tree from API output, ordering blocks in pre-order.

methods.name: insertBlocks
methods.description: Inserts blocks sequentially to preserve order, returns inserted children and skipped types.

methods.name: splitMarkdownByHeadings
methods.description: Splits markdown into chunks at top-level headings to stay within API limits.

methods.name: splitMarkdownBySize
methods.description: Splits markdown into chunks based on size, avoiding breaking inside fenced code blocks.

methods.name: convertMarkdownWithFallback
methods.description: Attempts to convert markdown, with retries and splitting on failure.

methods.name: chunkedConvertMarkdown
methods.description: Converts markdown in chunks to avoid size limits, normalizing block order.

methods.name: chunkedInsertBlocks
methods.description: Inserts blocks in batches to avoid API errors.

methods.name: readDoc
methods.description: Reads document content, metadata, and block info.

methods.name: createDoc
methods.description: Creates a new document, optionally granting permissions.

methods.name: writeDoc
methods.description: Deletes existing content, converts markdown, inserts blocks, and processes images.

methods.name: appendDoc
methods.description: Converts markdown and appends content to existing document.

methods.name: insertDoc
methods.description: Inserts content after a specified block ID.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a table block with specified size and optional column widths.

methods.name: writeTableCells
methods.description: Fills table cells with provided string values, converting markdown as needed.

methods.name: createTableWithValues
methods.description: Creates a table and fills it with specified values.

methods.name: updateBlock
methods.description: Updates text content of a block.

methods.name: deleteBlock
methods.description: Deletes a block by ID.

methods.name: listBlocks
methods.description: Lists all blocks in a document.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Retrieves a specific block.

methods.name: listAppScopes
methods.description: Lists current app permissions/scopes.

methods.name: registerFeishuDocTools
methods.description: Registers document operation tools with plugin API, including actions like read, write, insert, create, and media uploads.
